description: Unofficial Elephante fan-art companion inspired by the blue basic Neopets species. Compact upright elephant design with one trunk, broad ears, small pale wings and a yellow headcloth with a red gem; wing feather lobes are simplified for the drawing. Nine original motions include soft-ball placement and recovery, ear-fan flower display, note inspection, bipedal steps and a small hop. No official animation or affiliation is implied.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
